description: Consume a verified IgniteOnly wake packet and emit a compact public PushOnly worker envelope. It never writes source-of-truth state or executes the work.

ignite_result.description: Optional output from igniteonly_api or igniteonly_receipt_consumer.

painpoint_type.description: stale_ack, duplicate_wake, unclear_owner, queue_hydration_failure, noisy_thread, missing_proof, dormant_worker, or none.

public_fields_only.description: Must be true when supplying wake fields directly.

receipt_line.description: Optional compact receipt line copied from IgniteOnly.

source_id.description: Optional upstream event, dispatch, PR, issue, or wake identifier.

target.description: Human target label such as Boardroom backlog, PR #706, issue #706, or a dispatch ID.

verifier.description: Optional verifier text copied from IgniteOnly.

worker.description: Known worker route such as pinballwake-jobs-worker, Builder, Reviewer, Job Manager, or Heartbeat Seat.

name: pushonly_wake_pusher
